title: Toggle Link Chain
lock: The piece: a 50cm necklace of open elongated paperclip links, each link 4mm wide and 11mm long, in polished warm gold tone; it closes with 1 thick polished round gold-tone spring-gate ring 15mm across, a heavy round tube whose 2 flat-cut ends at the top are bridged by a slimmer gate wire, with 1 small ball push-pin nub on a grooved collar at about 3 o'clock; and 1 short slim straight bar 9mm long with flat ends, set along its length with a single row of about 9 tiny clear cubic zirconia, hanging from a small jump ring on the other chain end and threaded through the ring. The only stones are on that bar.
neg: The links must stay open elongated paperclip links, never cable, curb, rope or rolo links; the ring must stay a spring-gate sailor ring with its slimmer gate and push-pin nub, never a plain closed donut; the bar must stay short and straight, about 0.6 times the ring's width, never with ball ends, a hook or a shackle, never a lobster clasp; nothing hangs from the ring, no pendant, no charm.
doubts: Live price is Rs 1,299 (the build/BRIEF.md truth block still says Rs 1,499). The library lock says 'zero stones' and 'plain ring'; the listing photos show a spring-gate ring and a pave bar with about 9 clear stones, which is what this lock follows. The model tends to draw the pave bar too long; rhyme and quiet needed a reshoot for it.

title: Prism Rivière Bracelet
metal: rhodium plated silver tone (surgical stainless steel)
lock: The piece: an 18cm bracelet, one continuous line of about 21 square cushion-cut pastel cubic zirconia, each 5mm, in the repeating order aqua blue, soft pink, pale yellow, every stone framed by its own fine halo of 2 rows of tiny clear pave, each stone held by 4 short round bead claws at its corners, linked in bright rhodium silver tone, closed by 1 fold-over clasp.
neg: The stones must stay cushion-cut pastel stones in the repeating aqua, pink, yellow order, never all one colour, never round, never a fourth colour such as lilac or green, and no two neighbouring stones are ever the same colour; every stone keeps its halo of very fine clear pave, never bare, never long prongs; the metal stays cool bright silver, never gold.
doubts: The real piece's own close-up does not run a strict aqua-pink-yellow cycle; frames were passed when no two neighbours share a colour.

title: Woven Gold Hoops
lock: The piece: 1 pair of hoop earrings, each a round hoop 25mm across made of a thick braid of many polished gold-tone strands about 5mm thick around a 13mm opening, with raised ridges and shadow between the strands; at the top of each hoop 1 small flat round polished gold disc sits on the inner side just under where 1 thin hinged gold latch wire clicks shut; zero stones; pale warm yellow gold tone.
neg: The braid must stay a distinct interlaced braid of many fine gold strands with deep ridges, never a smooth tube, never a simple twisted rope, never chain links; both hoops stay identical round 25mm circles, never ovals, never larger; the disc stays solid polished gold, never a stone or enamel; no bail, no dangle.
doubts: Lock adds the flat polished disc and hinged latch seen in every listing photo (not in the library lock).

title: Heartbead Bracelet
metal: silver tone steel strand with 18k gold tone toggle and heart (surgical stainless steel)
lock: The piece: a strand of about 23 mirror-polished silver-tone steel spheres, each 6mm, with 1 smaller silver bead at each end, joined by fine silver links; it closes at the front with 1 round gold-tone toggle ring and 1 straight gold-tone T-bar, and exactly 1 puffed, smooth, polished gold-tone heart 15mm tall hangs from the ring on a small gold jump ring. Two metals: the strand silver, the toggle and heart gold.
neg: The beads must stay mirror-polished steel spheres that reflect their surroundings with one crisp white highlight each, never matte, never pearls, never black, never gold; the toggle and heart must stay gold, never silver; exactly 1 heart, puffed and plain, never flat, never engraved, never set with stones; never one single metal colour throughout.
doubts: Listing says mirror-polished silver-tone steel beads; in every listing photo they read grey-gunmetal because they mirror their surroundings. One older Shopify alt text calls them 'grey pearl', which is wrong.

title: Brushed Gold Huggies
metal: 18k gold tone, brushed satin (surgical stainless steel)
lock: The piece: 1 pair of huggie hoop earrings, each a wide, softly domed flat band 6mm deep curved into a small chunky huggie about 14mm tall and 10mm across, closing with a hidden hinge; soft brushed satin gold-tone surface with very fine parallel brush lines; zero stones.
neg: The finish must stay matte brushed satin that scatters light, never a smooth mirror polish; the band stays wide, smooth and plain, never ridged, twisted, hammered or set with stones; never a large hoop.
doubts: Size conflict: the live listing says about 14mm by 9.8mm with a 6mm band; the task and the fidelity library say 12mm. The lock follows the live listing. The pale satin gold reads silver beside saturated yellow (QUIET failed twice for that reason).

title: Ribbon Bead Bracelet
lock: The piece: a fine 1.2mm gold-tone cable chain, adjustable 16cm to 19cm, dotted with 2mm round gold satellite beads spaced along it; at the centre exactly 2 heart-cut clear cubic zirconia, each 5mm, set side by side in fine gold claws with their points meeting at a tiny gold centre bar, so the pair reads as 1 small bow 10mm wide and 5.5mm tall; a small gold lobster clasp with a short extender.
neg: The centre must stay 2 separate clear heart-cut stones meeting at their points, never merged into one stone, never a fabric or metal bow, never larger; the chain stays hair-fine, never thick; no other stones.
doubts: Same piece as the Edition Two 'Bow Chain Bracelet' (P16) lock. The model tends to draw the bow slightly large (1.3-1.5x).

title: Rivière Eternal Bracelet
lock: The piece: an 18cm bracelet, 1 continuous single row of about 45 round brilliant clear cubic zirconia, each 3mm, each in its own fine gold-tone four-prong basket, linked directly stone to stone; it closes with 1 polished rectangular gold-tone box clasp 12mm long and the same height as the stones, which sits in the line as a small plain polished buckle station.
neg: The stones must stay one row of round clear stones linked prong to prong, never two rows, never baguettes, never coloured, never a visible chain between the stones; the buckle stays one plain polished rectangle, never set with stones, never a lobster clasp; no dangle, no charm.
